summary_en: ESBN-YOLO improves small-target detection in noisy forward-looking sonar images using bidirectional multi-scale feature fusion, explicit Sobel edge features, and an NWD-plus-CIoU localization loss. It reports 88.67% mAP@0.5 on UATD and additional generalization tests on MDD and FDD.

title: Integrated two-photon and photoacoustic microscopy for single-cell neurometabolic imaging
authors: Jiaxiao Han; Youngseop Lee; Ziang Feng; Yue Wu; Zhuoying Wang; Allison Martinez Mejia; Adam Bauer; Manu Goyal; Jin-Moo Lee; Peinan Zhao; Hao F. Zhang; Cheng Sun; Song Hu
matched_query: integrated two-photon photoacoustic microscopy single-cell neurometabolic imaging optical acoustic multimodal microscopy
reasons: authoritative metadata verified from the Nature Communications article page
summary_en: An integrated two-photon and photoacoustic microscopy platform that simultaneously measures single-neuron calcium activity and oxygen release from individual red blood cells in awake mice. A transparent micro-ring resonator ultrasound sensor preserves optical access while maintaining acoustic sensitivity, enabling real-time cellular-scale neurometabolic imaging.

title: Design of optomechanical transducers for sub-micron resolution ultrasound imaging
authors: Lisa Hackett; Chang Ge; Alex Miera; Brandon Smith; Matt Eichenfield
matched_query: optomechanical transducer sub-micron ultrasound imaging acoustic optical sensor nano-optomechanical cavity
reasons: authoritative metadata verified from the official arXiv record
summary_en: A nano-optomechanical cavity platform designed to generate and detect approximately 5 GHz ultrasound in aqueous media, targeting sub-micron, label-free imaging at cellular and sub-cellular scales. The analysis predicts signal-to-noise ratios in the thousands under diffraction and thermal-acoustic noise limits.
